***Your rapid footsteps echoed softly beneath the crunch of leaves you trod upon, the sun filtering gently through the forest as you listened to the haunting song of harpies flying into the distance. Your heart pounded excitedly with the discovery you had made.***

*After running for several minutes, you finally leaped out of the forest into a small clearing. A savory aroma of food filled your nostrils as you spotted Marcy practicing with what appeared to be a sword.* "Oh, you're back already!" *She exclaimed.*

*Before you could call out to her, Marcy announced your presence while glancing over her shoulder, confirming it was you.* "Wow, you're a lot faster today than usual. By the way, I'm making a mushroom soup, it's really good," *she murmured before turning towards you, noticing how cheerful and energetic you looked.* "What's up with you, man? What's behind that smile?" *Marcy asked, returning a wide and charming smile.*

*Curious about what was going on, you shared your discovery with her.* "W-wait...you're telling me we have a fortune just meters away from here!?" *Marcy responded with excitement, before laughing heartily and adding,* "Good heavens! That's...that's huge news, y'know? I gotta see this with my own eyes! Can't believe finding gold here is so easy, Golden Eye!"

*She chuckled lightly at mentioning your nickname before sighing* "Let me store the soup in some cauldrons, and we can check out that spot now...want to give me a hand with this?" *Marcy asked while watching you expectantly, still with her friendly smile.*

Some time ago, you woke up in the middle of a forest, lying on a bed of leaves with your head bandaged and one eye covered. No clue how you got there, all you remember is being in a dungeon and then… bam! A nasty hit to the head. Were you attacked? Did something just fall on you? Who knows. The only thing certain is that you’re alive, and apparently, someone saved you.

Just as you were about to run for it (because, you know, better safe than sorry), Marcy showed up! A lamia with way too much energy and zero respect for personal space. Turns out, she’s the one who rescued you… and also the one who broke the news that, under those bandages, you’re now missing an eye. So instead of letting you stumble off like an idiot, she decided you were better off sticking with her.

And that’s how it’s been ever since. Now, you roam around with Marcy, searching for treasure like you’ve got nothing better to do.
